items.title: 19.1 Mass defect aur binding energy (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of mass defect and binding energy (PDF 138-140).

blocks.text: Nuclei ki kamiyat par tajurbat dikhate hain ke nucleus ki kamiyat hamesha use banane wale protons aur neutrons ki kul kamiyat se kam hoti hai. Ghaib kamiyat mass defect hai: dm = [Z mp + (A - Z) mn] - m_nucleus (19.1), jahan mp proton ki kamiyat, mn neutron ki kamiyat aur m_nucleus poore nucleus ki kamiyat hai. Ghaib kamiyat nucleus bante waqt tawanai mein badal gayi hai, jo Einstein ke kamiyat-tawanai talluq se milti hai: dE = (dm) c^2 (19.2). Yeh tawanai nucleus ki binding energy (B.E.) hai.

blocks.title: Binding energy
blocks.text: Nucleus ki binding energy woh kaam hai jo nucleus ko us ke ajza, neutrons aur protons, mein torne ke liye karna parta hai. Mustahkami ka behtar paimana binding energy fi nucleon hai, yani nucleus ko alag alag nucleons mein juda karne ke liye darkaar aust tawanai.

Binding energy ko manfi samjha ja sakta hai, jaise infinity par sifar li gayi gravitational potential energy: bandha nucleus apne juda hisson se kam tawanai rakhta hai. Zer-e-atomic zarrat ki kamiyat aam taur par atomic mass units (u) mein di jati hai: 1 u carbon-12 ke atom ki kamiyat ka barahwan hissa hai, 1 u = 1.66 x 10^-27 kg (1.66 x 10^-24 g). Kitab kuch atomic kamiyatein u mein deti hai: e 0.00055, n 1.008665, 1H 1.007825, 2H 2.014102, 3H 3.01605, 3He 3.01603, 4He 4.002603, 7Li 7.016004, 10Be 10.013534, 14N 14.0031 aur 17O 16.9991.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghaltiyan
blocks.text: Kitab 1 u ko 2-6-C likhe carbon atom ki kamiyat ka '1/112' batati hai; yeh carbon-12 ke atom ki kamiyat ka 1/12 hai. Kitab ki table 1H ke liye 1.007276 u deti hai, jo asal mein proton ki kamiyat hai; hydrogen atom ki kamiyat 1.007825 u hai, aur yahi oopar likhi gayi hai. Kitab binding energy ko us gravitational potential jaisa kehti hai jo 'zameen ki satah par' sifar liya jaye; mutlaq (absolute) gravitational potential infinity par sifar liya jata hai, is liye oopar 'infinity par sifar' likha hai.

blocks.alt: Protons (+) aur neutrons ka nucleus, 'Nucleus (smaller mass)', jama 'Binding energy' ka dabba, teer ke baad wahi protons aur neutrons alag alag bikhre hue, 'Separated nucleons (greater mass)'.
blocks.caption: Aap ki maloomat ke liye: nucleus ko us ke protons aur neutrons mein todne ke liye tawanai deni parti hai (kitab ke box ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Nucleus ko torne ke liye binding energy bahar se deni parti hai. Is liye alag alag nucleons ki kul kamiyat (greater mass) nucleus ki kamiyat (smaller mass) se zyada hoti hai; yahi farq mass defect hai.

Helium nucleus ka mass defect aur binding energy maloom karein, jab mp = 1.672623 x 10^-27 kg, mn = 1.674929 x 10^-27 kg aur m_nucleus = 6.646786 x 10^-27 kg. Hal: dm = 2 mp + 2 mn - m_nucleus = 2(1.672623) x 10^-27 + 2(1.674929) x 10^-27 - 6.646786 x 10^-27 = 6.695104 x 10^-27 - 6.646786 x 10^-27 = 0.048318 x 10^-27 kg. B.E. = dm c^2 = 0.048318 x 10^-27 kg x (3.0 x 10^8 m s^-1)^2 = 4.34862 x 10^-12 J. Electron volts mein B.E. = 4.34862 x 10^-12 / 1.6 x 10^-19 = 2.7 x 10^7 eV = 27 MeV, taqreeban 6.8 MeV fi nucleon.

Nucleon number A ke muqable binding energy fi nucleon ka graph (Fig 19.1) dikhata hai ke nucleus kitna mustahkam hai aur kya fission ya fusion se us se tawanai mil sakti hai. Hydrogen nucleus, sirf aik proton ke saath, ki binding energy sifar hai. Hydrogen se helium tak izafa bara hai, jo batata hai ke hydrogen ko helium mein badalne se bohat tawanai nikalti hai. Curve iron, 56-26-Fe, ke liye taqreeban 8.7 MeV fi nucleon ki inteha tak pohanchta hai, jo sab se mustahkam nuclide hai; sab se mustahkam nuclei A = 50 aur 80 ke darmiyan hain. Us ke baad binding energy fi nucleon curve ke aakhir tak ahista ahista ghatti hai.

Yun bohat halke aur bohat bhari nuclei ki binding energy fi nucleon kam hai. Agar bhari nucleus do aise nuclei mein toote jo curve ki chotti ke qareeb hon to un ke nucleons zyada mazbooti se bandhe hote hain: yeh nuclear fission hai, jo pehle hi bohat zyada bijli banane mein use ho raha hai. Isi tarah agar do halke nuclei mil kar aik nucleus banayein, jaise deuterium aur tritium mil kar zyada mustahkam helium nucleus banate hain, to bohat zyada tawanai nikalti hai: yeh fusion hai. Ise shuru karna mushkil hai aur bohat zyada darja hararat chahiye, jaise Sooraj aur doosre sitaron mein. Aam taur par har aise nuclear reaction se tawanai milti hai jis mein products ki binding energy fi nucleon barh jaye.

blocks.alt: Nucleon number A (0 se 250) ke muqable binding energy fi nucleon (0 se -10 MeV, neeche ki taraf) ka graph. Curve H (0) se shuru ho kar Li aur Be se tezi se girta, Mg se guzar kar Fe ke qareeb taqreeban -8.8 MeV par sab se neeche pohanchta, phir Ag, I, Hg, Bi aur Ra se ahista uth kar 235U par taqreeban -7.6 MeV tak jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.1: nucleon number ke muqable ausat binding energy fi nucleon (kitab ki Figure 19.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab binding energy ko manfi maanti hai, is liye graph 0 se -10 MeV ki taraf neeche jata hai: curve jitna neeche, nucleus utna mazbooti se bandha. Iron (Fe) ke qareeb curve sab se neeche (taqreeban -8.7 MeV) hai. Kitab ne 'Bi' ka teer A = 80 ke qareeb aur 'I' ka teer A = 150 ke qareeb chhapa hai; bismuth (Bi) ka mass number 209 aur iodine (I) ka 127 hai, is liye hum ne dono teer sahi jagah lagaye hain. Kitab ke matan ka 'building energy per nucleon' binding energy fi nucleon hai.

blocks.prompt: u mein kamiyat istemal kar ke deuteron (2H) ki binding energy maloom karein, 1 u = 931.5 MeV le kar.
blocks.explanation: 1.007276 u proton kamiyat ke saath: dm = 1.007276 + 1.008665 - (2.014102 - 0.00055) = 0.00239 u, is liye B.E. = 0.00239 x 931.5 = 2.2 MeV (taqreeban 1.1 MeV fi nucleon).
